display.purpose: Main page title and empty-state headings.

label.purpose: Compact field labels and state markers.

shadows.name: notice-float
shadows.purpose: Separate transient notices from the work area.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Warm signal action for analyzing a source.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #C17D3E; border-radius: 4px; background: #E6A45F; color: #211810; font: 700 11px Barlow, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, transform 140ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { border-color: #F0B36F; background: #F0B36F; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #EFBD83; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: URL Field
components.description: Dark inset field for a video or playlist URL.
components.css: .ds-url-field { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 49px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #3A453D; border-radius: 6px; background: #141A16; color: #F0F2ED; } .ds-url-field input { min-width: 0; width: 100%; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 400 12px Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-url-field input::placeholder { color: #8E9890; opacity: 1; } .ds-url-field:focus-within { border-color: #98744C; } .ds-url-field:focus-within input:focus-visible { outline: 0; }

components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: Tonal active state with a narrow orange marker.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid #3B443E; border-radius: 6px; background: #202722; color: #F0F2ED; font: 600 13px Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-active::before { position: absolute; left: -1px; top: 10px; bottom: 10px; width: 2px; content: ''; background: #E6A45F; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #EFBD83; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Demonstration Label
components.description: Labels synthetic content so it cannot be mistaken for analyzed media.
components.css: .ds-demo-chip { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px 5px; border: 1px solid #57442F; border-radius: 3px; color: #E4B981; font: 700 8px Barlow, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; }

components.name: Output Rail
components.description: One flat panel for format, quality, destination, and batch summary.
components.css: .ds-output-rail { min-width: 0; padding: 17px 16px 14px; border: 1px solid #3A453D; border-radius: 6px; background: #1A211D; color: #DCE1DC; } .ds-output-rail h2 { margin: 0; color: #F0F2ED; font: 650 15px Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-output-rail p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: #7C8980; font: 400 11px/1.45 Barlow, sans-serif; }

components.name: Playlist Ledger Row
components.description: Ordered row that keeps selection and availability legible.
components.css: .ds-ledger-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 32px minmax(0, 1fr) 64px 100px; align-items: center; min-height: 53px; border-top: 1px solid #29312C; color: #DCE1DC; font: 500 12px Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-ledger-row:hover { background: #1B221E; } .ds-ledger-number, .ds-ledger-duration { color: #99A49B; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ledger-status { color: #92BF9A; font-size: 10px; }

components.name: Format Selector
components.description: Compact segmented choice with a clear active edge.
components.css: .ds-format-option { display: grid; place-content: center; gap: 2px; min-height: 47px; border: 1px solid #3A453D; background: #171D19; color: #99A49B; font: 600 10px Barlow, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-format-option:hover { background: #202722; color: #DCE1DC; } .ds-format-option[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #34291E; color: #F3D2A8; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #E6A45F; } .ds-format-option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #EFBD83; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Clipoteca treats every URL as a batch that can be inspected and managed. The interface borrows the clarity of a media-ingest ledger: ordered entries, visible status, explicit output controls, and no hidden steps. Its dark appearance is grounded in a Windows desktop work session, not in a generic “tech” aesthetic.

Graphite-green surfaces and fine rules keep the manifest readable; warm signal orange marks the active choice and primary action. The system is dense enough to make playlist work practical, but every state remains legible and honest. Demonstration content is labeled as such until a real source is analyzed.
keyCharacteristics: Playlist ledger before decorative media cards.
Dark graphite-green planes with fine structural divisions.
Signal orange reserved for active and actionable states.
Clear, numbered media rows and tabular durations.
Prototype and availability states are explicit.

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Orange belongs to a selected state, a primary action, or a meaningful status—not to decoration.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A control is raised only when its interaction or temporary status needs separation.

dos: Do label synthetic playlist data and unconnected functionality as a prototype.
Do keep media order and item-level availability visible.
Do keep the source, manifest, and output options close enough to compare at a glance.
Do use the signal color only for actions, selections, and meaningful states.
donts: Don't present sample metadata as if it came from an analyzed URL.
Don't imply a setting is saved when it is only a visual placeholder.
Don't replace playlist rows with equal-sized content cards.
Don't hide or truncate availability status on narrow windows.
